```{r}
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
#read the ward data in
LondonWards <- st_read(here::here("data", "wk1","statistical-gis-boundaries-london","statistical-gis-boundaries-london","ESRI", "London_Ward.shp"))
```
```{r}
LondonWardsMerged <- st_read(here::here("data", "wk1",
                                        "statistical-gis-boundaries-london", 
                                        "statistical-gis-boundaries-london",
                                        "ESRI",
                                        "London_Ward_CityMerged.shp"))%>%
  st_transform(.,27700)
```
```{r}
WardData <- read_csv("https://data.london.gov.uk/download/f33fb38c-cb37-48e3-8298-84c0d3cc5a6c/772d2d64-e8c6-46cb-86f9-e52b4c7851bc/ward-profiles-excel-version.csv",
                    locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                     na = c("NA", "n/a")) %>% 
  clean_names()

LondonWardsMerged <- LondonWardsMerged %>% 
  left_join(WardData, 
            by = c("GSS_CODE" = "new_code"))%>%
  dplyr::distinct(GSS_CODE, .keep_all = T)%>%
  dplyr::select(GSS_CODE, ward_name, average_gcse_capped_point_scores_2014)
```
```{r}
#have a look to check that it's 
#in the right projection
st_crs(LondonWardsMerged)
```

library(tmap)

BluePlaques <- st_read(here::here("data", "wk6",

example

```{r}
check_example <- LondonWardsMerged%>%
  st_join(BluePlaquesSub)%>%
  filter(ward_name=="Kingston upon Thames - Coombe Hill")
```

```{r}
library(sf)
points_sf_joined <- LondonWardsMerged%>%
  mutate(n = lengths(st_intersects(., BluePlaquesSub)))%>%
  janitor::clean_names()%>%
  #calculate area
  mutate(area=st_area(.))%>%
  #then density of the points per ward
  mutate(density=n/area)%>%
  #select density and some other variables 
  dplyr::select(density, ward_name, gss_code, n, average_gcse_capped_point_scores_2014)
```
```{r}
points_sf_joined<- points_sf_joined %>%                    
  group_by(gss_code) %>%         
  summarise(density = first(density),
          wardname= first(ward_name),
          plaquecount= first(n))

tm_shape(points_sf_joined) +
    tm_polygons(
      fill = "density",
      fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
        values = "brewer.blues",
        style="jenks"),
      # set the legend
      fill.legend = tm_legend(title="Blue Plaque Density",
                              title.size=0.85,
                              size=0.8,
                              # plot outside of the main map
                              #explained below
                              position=tm_pos_out("right", 
                                                  "center",
                                                  pos.v = "center")))
```
```{r}
library(spdep)
```
```{r}
#First calculate the centroids of all Wards in London

coordsW <- points_sf_joined%>%
  st_centroid()%>% # 为每个选区计算一个质心
  st_geometry() # 只取出这些质心的空间位置
  
plot(coordsW,axes=TRUE)
```
```{r}
#create a neighbours list
LWard_nb <- points_sf_joined %>%
  poly2nb(., queen=T)
summary(LWard_nb)
```
```{r}
#plot them
plot(LWard_nb, st_geometry(coordsW), col="red") # 先画选区边界
#add a map underneath
plot(points_sf_joined$geometry, add=T) # 再连接相邻选区的质心
```
```{r}
# 把邻居名单转成矩阵：每一行和每一列都代表一个选区，两个选区相邻就填 1，否则填 0
#create a spatial weights matrix from these weights
Lward.lw <- LWard_nb %>%
  nb2mat(., style="B")

sum(Lward.lw)
```
```{r}
sum(Lward.lw[1,])
```
```{r}
Lward.lw <- LWard_nb %>%
  nb2listw(., style="C")# 每条邻接关系分到相同的权重，这里是 625/3680 ≈ 0.17
```

## Moran’s I 
莫兰指数 I = 0.67（记住，1 表示聚集，0 表示无模式，-1 表示分散），这表明我们存在一些明显的聚集现象。但这可能是任何程度的聚集。
```{r}
# 检验从整个伦敦来看，相邻选区的蓝牌密度是否倾向于相似
I_LWard_Global_Density <- points_sf_joined %>%
  pull(density) %>%
  as.vector()%>%  # 把密度值转成普通数值向量，顺序与选区表一致
  moran.test(., Lward.lw) # 结合选区的邻居关系和权重，做全局 Moran’s I 检验

I_LWard_Global_Density  # 显示检验结果
```
## Geary’s C
C < 1 indicates that neighbours with similar values are clustered (compared to random chance)
C < 1 表示具有相似值的邻居聚集在一起（与随机情况相比）。
C >1 indicates that neighbours with dissimilar values are clustered (compared to random chance).
C > 1 表示具有不同值的邻居聚集在一起（与随机情况相比）。
C = 0 indicates not autocorrelation
C = 0 表示不存在自相关性
```{r}
C_LWard_Global_Density <- 
  points_sf_joined %>%
  pull(density) %>%
  as.vector()%>%
  geary.test(., Lward.lw) # 根据邻居权重，比较相邻选区的密度差异

C_LWard_Global_Density # 查看全局 Geary’s C 和 p 值
```
## Getis Ord
The General G statistic = G > expected, so high values are tending to cluster.
一般 G 统计量 = G > 预期值，因此高值往往聚集在一起。
```{r}
G_LWard_Global_Density <- 
  points_sf_joined %>%
  pull(density) %>%
  as.vector()%>%
  globalG.test(., Lward.lw) # 用邻居权重检验高密度（默认）选区是否倾向于相邻

G_LWard_Global_Density
```
##  Local Moran’s I  
```{r}
#use the localmoran function to generate I for each ward in the city

I_LWard_Local_count <- points_sf_joined %>%
  pull(plaquecount) %>%
  as.vector()%>%
  localmoran(., Lward.lw)%>%
  as_tibble() # 把结果整理成表格，每行对应一个 ward

I_LWard_Local_Density <- points_sf_joined %>%
  pull(density) %>%
  as.vector()%>%
  localmoran(., Lward.lw)%>%
  as_tibble()

#what does the output (the localMoran object) look like?
slice_head(I_LWard_Local_Density, n=5)
```
```{r}
points_sf_joined <- points_sf_joined %>%
  mutate(plaque_count_I = as.numeric(I_LWard_Local_count$Ii))%>%
  mutate(plaque_count_Iz =as.numeric(I_LWard_Local_count$Z.Ii))%>%
  mutate(density_I =as.numeric(I_LWard_Local_Density$Ii))%>%
  mutate(density_Iz =as.numeric(I_LWard_Local_Density$Z.Ii))
```

```{r}
breaks1<-c(-1000,-2.58,-1.96,-1.65,1.65,1.96,2.58,1000)
```

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
MoranColours<- rev(brewer.pal(7, "RdGy")) #把这 7 种颜色的顺序反过来，从灰色一端排到红色一端。
tm_shape(points_sf_joined) +
    tm_polygons(
      fill = "plaque_count_Iz", # 按蓝牌数量的局部 Moran Z 分数给选区上色
      fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.br_bg", # 用棕—蓝绿色带
                                      midpoint = "NA", # 中间色给中间一档
                                      style = "fixed", # 自己指定分界点
                                      breaks=breaks1),
       fill.legend = tm_legend(title="Local Moran's I, Blue Plaques in London",
                              title.size=0.85,
                              size=0.8,
                              # plot outside of the main map
                              #explained below
                              position=tm_pos_out("right", 
                                                  "center",
                                                  pos.v = "center")))
```
